kitBriefs.eric: Enemy attack down · incoming damage down · squad health up
kitBriefs.hilde: Attack and defense up · damage proc · damage-reduction proc
kitBriefs.jaeger: Damage proc · enemy lethality-reduction proc · health up
kitBriefs.zoe: Damage over time · attack up · damage-taken amplification
kitBriefs.saul: Defense and health up · lethality up
kitBriefs.amadeus: Lethality up · attack up · damage proc
kitBriefs.petra: Damage-taken amplification proc · attack proc · damage-reduction proc

lineups.title: Zoe, Hilde, Saul
lineups.lesson: Zoe adds attack and damage amplification. Saul adds lethality, defense and health.
lineups.comparison: Compare return damage as well as survival: clearing the rally leaves troops for the next hold.

lineups.title: Eric, Hilde, Jaeger
lineups.lesson: Eric reduces enemy attack and incoming damage, and adds health. Jaeger adds health and a chance to reduce enemy lethality.
lineups.comparison: Compare Eric with your Zoe and Jaeger with your Saul at their actual development.

lineups.title: Eric, Hilde, Jaeger
lineups.lesson: Eric and Jaeger add squad-wide survival. Hilde adds damage support and a damage-reduction chance.
lineups.comparison: Try Zoe or Saul when you need more return damage. Check defender widgets too.

lineups.title: Amadeus, Hilde, Marlin
lineups.lesson: Amadeus adds attack, lethality and a damage proc. Marlin adds damage procs and enemy lethality reduction.
lineups.comparison: Hilde still supplies attack, defense and damage. Her defender widget is only part of the kit.

lineups.title: Amadeus, Petra, Marlin
lineups.lesson: Petra adds attack and damage-taken amplification procs, damage reduction and a rally attack widget.
lineups.comparison: Compare with your developed Hilde using battle reports.

lineups.title: Amadeus, Petra, Marlin
lineups.lesson: Attack, lethality and damage effects combine here, with rally widgets supporting the role.
lineups.comparison: Compare survivors and losses too. A survival skill can still improve an attacking rally.
